page.layout: One printed page. Main text in one column, with marginal notes in the right margin: "II." beside the second paragraph, and "Pearf." with "c.2. p.15." beside the following lines. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: verum est quod addit Pearsonius, pace illius dixerim, Dallæum Epistolas ipsas accuratissime infpicientem & diligentissime rimantem, nihil adhuc hujus generis offendisse; contrarium certe ex ijs quae scripturi sumus patebit, & ita dilucide ut in dubium vocari nequeat, quin Valentini hæresis post Ignatij mortem orta, Epistolarum confarcinatori cognita fuerit.

Hisce delibatis pergit Vir doctus, & ut II. ea quæ Dallæus adversus Epistolas Eusebio cognitas ex ipsis observavit, nullam Pearf. omnino ad earum Autoritatem immi-nuendam vim habere ostendat, profitetur se eodem ordine quo Dallæus perscripsit singulatim omnia persequuturum esse. Incipit autem Dallæus ab argumento à tempore ducto, & cap. X. affirmat non pauca passim occurrere, quæ statam atque immotam temporum fidem, certissimum veritatis [?]ἐκεῖ- c.2. p.15.νον, graviter pulsant ac convellunt; plura ejusmodi adfert in illo capite, sed præter unum Hieronymi testimonium, cætera Vindiciarum Auctorem non feriunt, quoniam desumpta sunt vel ex Epistolis quas ipse rejicit, vel ex interpolationibus quibus contaminatæ fuerunt, quas pro germanis habet; Dallæus videlicet, hoc Ignatianarum Epistolarum negotium simul semelque totum tractare in se suscepit; ideoque

page.notes: The Greek word split at the line end ("ἐκεῖ-" / "νον") is a doubtful reading; the first part is marked [?]. The "V" below the last line, centred and not at the right, is a printer's mark or catchword-like sign, not transcribed as a catchword. The "II." and "Pearf." marks are margin notes; "c.2. p.15." is a reference beside the line. Printed ligature forms (Epistolas, Hisce) are rendered with ordinary letters.
